title: 'Kanojo, Okarishimasu' Sixth Season Announced
content: The official website of the Kanojo, Okarishimasu ( Rent-a-Girlfriend ) television anime announced a sixth season on Saturday. The character designer, Kanna Hirayama , drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement (pictured above).
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Shuumatsu no Walküre' Gets Fourth Season
content: Production company Warner Bros. Japan announced a fourth season for the Shuumatsu no Walküre ( Record of Ragnarok ) anime series on Friday, revealing a special announcement promotional video, and a commemorative illustration (pictured) by the manga's illustrator Ajichika .
author: MyAnimeList

title: Eleceed TV Anime Reveals Key Visual, Delayed 2027 Debut
content: Amuse Creative Studio revealed on Friday a key visual and a delayed 2027 debut for the television anime adaptation of author Jeho Son and artist ZHENA webtoon series ELECEED : The company originally announced a 2026 premiere.
author: ANN

title: 'Snowball Earth' Gets Second Season
content: The 13th and final episode of Snowball Earth ended with an announcement on Friday that a second season is in production. The official website also revealed an announcement promo and celebratory visual (pictured above). Produced by Studio KAI , the first season premiered on April 3.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Perfect Addiction 'Light Anime' Debuts on July 8
content: An advanced screening event planned for Saturday was canceled due to the approaching typhoon. The anime stars Yōhei Azakami as Akihito Kuji (left in image at right), and Sōma Saitō as Sae Takatsuki.
author: ANN

title: New Hokuto no Ken -Fist of the North Star- Anime's 2nd Part Premieres in 2027
content: Warner Bros. Japan announced on Friday that the second cours (quarter of a year) of Hokuto no Ken -Fist of the North Star- , the new anime of Tetsuo Hara 's landmark manga Fist of the North Star ( Hokuto no Ken ), will start in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Record of Ragnarok Anime Gets 4th Season
content: Warner Bros. Japan announced on Friday that the anime based on Shinya Umemura , Azychika , and Takumi Fukui 's Record of Ragnarok ( Shūmatsu no Walküre ) manga will get a fourth season titled Record of Ragnarok IV .
author: ANN

title: Snowball Earth Anime Gets 2nd Season
content: The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Yuhiro Tsujitsugu 's Snowball Earth manga announced on Friday that the series is getting a second season. The staff unveiled a trailer: The first season's 13th and final episode aired on Friday.
author: ANN

title: The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me Anime's Promo Video Reveals Cast, October Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazami Sawatari and illustrator Aitiki's Shiotaiō no Satō-san ga Ore ni Dake Amai ( The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me ) light novel series revealed on Friday the first key visual, promotional video, additional cast, and October 2026 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Berserk Gives Guts a Major Upgrade And Nothing Will Ever Be The Same
content: Berserk has finally returned, with writer Kouji Mori and the artists of Studio Gaga once again returning to Guts’ life to show the Black Swordsman in one of his most dire predicaments to date.
author: ComicBook
